tunnel_250.full: a round running tunnel of the Moscow metro north of VDNKh station, about 5.5 m across, ribbed concrete lining stained black with soot and seepage, bundles of old cables along both walls, two rusty rails on wooden sleepers. A distance number '250' is painted on the wall and a black-and-white striped post stands by the track. The outpost is a small low campfire, flames no higher than a hand span, beside the track, a metre from the rails, with wooden crates as seats around it. Beyond the circle of firelight the tunnel falls into total darkness in both directions.
tunnel_250.short: sooty ribbed concrete of a metro tunnel, warm flickering firelight, darkness around.

peregon_savelovskaya.full: a running tunnel of the Moscow metro towards Savyolovskaya station, round ribbed concrete lining, cables along the walls, two rails on wooden sleepers. Ahead there is light and a wall of sandbags across the track with a narrow passage, warm light behind it: a flamethrower post guarding the tunnel.
peregon_savelovskaya.short: ribbed concrete of a metro tunnel, sandbags, warm light from behind them, darkness elsewhere.

north_cordon.full: the north cordon of VDNKh, a fortified post in a cast-iron segmented metro tunnel: bolted iron ring segments, sandbag walls across the track, a machine gun on a mount, wooden crates, a heavy searchlight on a stand throwing a hard white beam down the tunnel. Outside the beam the tunnel is black.
north_cordon.short: bolted cast-iron tunnel segments, sandbags, hard white searchlight beam, black beyond it.

vdnkh.full: VDNKh metro station in 2033 turned into a settlement: a long pylon hall with arches between massive marble pylons; worn army tents pitched inside the arches, plywood shacks along the outer walls, laundry hanging on lines. The main light is red emergency lighting, dimmer at night; the vaults above stay in shadow. At the dead end beyond the colonnade is the tea place: thousands of white mushroom caps drying on wires above small smouldering fires.
vdnkh.short: worn marble and canvas of a metro station settlement under dim red emergency light.

botanical.full: Botanical Garden metro station, abandoned and dark: a shallow three-span column station with two rows of columns, the foot of a long escalator shaft with stopped escalators, broken balustrades and exposed gear wheels in the gaps, a steel control lever by the escalator landing. On the floor: embers of old campfires, half-burnt books, a broken doll. No station lights; only the lantern the people carry.
botanical.short: dusty stone of an abandoned metro station, lantern light only, darkness around.

botanical_vestibule.full: the surface vestibule of Botanical Garden station at night: a round rotunda under a concrete half-dome, the roof half collapsed; through it the sky is dark blue, huge and full of stars. Debris and dust on the floor.
botanical_vestibule.short: broken concrete of a ruined rotunda under a dark blue starry night sky.

sukhoi_tent.full: inside the army tent of Sukhoi, Artyom's stepfather, at VDNKh station: canvas walls, shelves made of open wooden crates packed with old books, two folding camp beds along the walls, a table, a single bare bulb hanging on a cord from the ridge. Through the door flap the station outside glows faint red.
sukhoi_tent.short: canvas tent interior lit by a single bare bulb, faint red glow outside.

timiryazevskaya.full: Timiryazevskaya metro station in 2014, inhabited: a single-vault hall without pylons, dim cold lamps, people living on the platform; in the western track wall a dark side tunnel opens into blackness.
timiryazevskaya.short: single concrete vault of a metro station under dim cold lamps.

vdnkh_office.full: the station administration office at VDNKh: a cramped room in the station's service rooms, a heavy old desk with a map of Alekseevskaya station spread on it, papers, a single desk lamp, concrete walls.
vdnkh_office.short: cramped concrete office lit by a single desk lamp.

white_room.full: a vision, not a real place: an endless seamless white room with soft even light from everywhere, no shadows, no visible walls or edges.
white_room.short: seamless white void with soft even light, no shadows.
